name: Team Fortress 2
description: Valve's classic class-based shooter. SRCDS dedicated server installed via SteamCMD (anonymous).

variables.label: RCON password
variables.description: Enables console commands via Source RCON (on the game port) when set. Leave empty to disable RCON.

notes: Server config lives in tf/cfg/server.cfg (hostname, rcon_password, sv_password). A GSLT from steamcommunity.com/dev/managegameservers (app 440) is recommended for public servers: +sv_setsteamaccount <token>. Windows hosts: set the start command override to srcds.exe -game tf with the same arguments. 64-bit builds also ship srcds_run_64.
